Name: Needs Stat
Author: Vlasidi
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
Adds Need stats for your player similar to in The Sims:

Hunger
Thirst (replaces bladder)
Hygiene
Social
Fun
Comfort

And overall mood (an average of all other stats)

Also includes 2 custom items and 1 custom farm building.

Full Transparency: This mod was created with the assistance of ai. All ideas, custom items, implementations etc. were designed by me. I used an ai tool to help with the coding as I am not very good at it yet.
[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Unzip folder and place both sub folders (NeedsAndMood and NeedsAndMood Content) in the Stardew Valley/Mods folder[/color]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Adds Need stats for your player similar to in The Sims:

Hunger
Thirst (replaces bladder)
Hygiene
Social
Fun
Comfort[/color]

Stats go down over time and with certain activities and can be restored through various methods such as eating, drinking, reading a book, sitting on a chair etc.

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Requires Content Patcher.[/color][/size]
